obligation_records.statement: Pure shell/view-state commands change visible panel/subview/layout but do not own canonical target identity; route-consuming commands must reveal a specific object or scope and normalize through route_target.
obligation_records.evidence_ledger_excerpt:
Pure shell/view-state commands should stay local and lightweight. They change what panel/subview/layout is visible, but they do not own canonical target identity.
- Route-consuming navigation commands are the ones that must reveal a specific object or scope. They should normalize through the emerging `route_target` model
exact_items: Pure shell/view-state commands change visible panel/subview/layout but do not own canonical target identity
route-consuming commands must reveal a specific object or scope and normalize through route_target.
